evals.name: physics-formula-sheet
evals.prompt: Can you go through evals/heldout/lecture7_ideal_gases.pdf and make me a sheet with every formula and what follows from what? I always get lost in which equation comes from which
evals.expected_output: One formula-sheet PDF in English: dependency diagram, numbered formulas with a 'from what / how' column. Flags TV^γ = const (should be TV^(γ−1)) and the Carnot example (40%, not 60%).
assertions: Produces a formula-sheet PDF
Shows a dependency diagram of which formula leads to which
Lists numbered formulas, each with where it comes from and how
Flags 'TV^γ = const' as wrong (correct: TV^(γ−1) = const)
Flags the Carnot example: efficiency is 40%, not 60%
Covers Mayer's relation, isothermal work nRT ln(V2/V1) and adiabatic work
Written in English

evals.name: mc-photos-solutions
evals.prompt: here are photos of last year's midterm MC part: evals/heldout/ec220_midterm_photo1.jpg and evals/heldout/ec220_midterm_photo2.jpg. solve them and explain why the wrong options are wrong pls
evals.expected_output: One solutions PDF in English opening with an answer table: 1b 2c 3b 4d 5b 6a 7c 8c, each with why the distractors are wrong.
assertions: Produces a solutions PDF
Opens with an answer table before the worked solutions
All eight answers correct: 1b, 2c, 3b, 4d, 5b, 6a, 7c, 8c
Explains why each wrong option is wrong (e.g. Q4 (b) 12 forgets to square the 3; Q7 (a) confuses sensitivity with P(ill|+))
Q1 shows P(A∩B) = 0.2 = P(A)P(B), so independent, and P(A|B) = 0.5
Written in English

evals.name: spanish-cheat-sheet
evals.prompt: make me a one-page cheat sheet from this for my exam: evals/heldout/tema3_elasticidades.docx
evals.expected_output: One cheat-sheet PDF, A4 landscape, 1 page (2 max), in Spanish. Flags the reversed elastic/inelastic definition. Decimal commas.
assertions: Produces a single cheat-sheet PDF
Landscape and at most 2 pages
Written in Spanish, the language of the notes
Flags the definition 'elástica si |ε| < 1' as reversed (elastic means |ε| > 1)
Decimals use a comma (−0,67, 266,7), none printed with a point
Keeps the worked numbers: ε = −0,67, IT max at P = 25, EC = 400, EP ≈ 266,7

evals.name: no-latex-html-route
evals.prompt: solve worksheet evals/heldout/worksheet9_calculus.docx step by step pls, I want to check my answers. Note: this machine has no LaTeX installation (no latexmk/pdflatex/xelatex/lualatex/tectonic); do not try to install one.
evals.expected_output: A solutions PDF produced without LaTeX (HTML + browser print), math rendered, A4. Flags the key's answer to Q2 (should be −x²/4).
assertions: Produces a solutions PDF without using LaTeX
Math is rendered (no raw TeX such as \frac or $ in the PDF text)
PDF is A4
Flags the answer key's Q2 as wrong: ∫x ln x dx = x²/2 ln x − x²/4 + C
All five answers correct: e^(3x)(2x+3x²); x²/2 ln x − x²/4 + C; 3; y = x/4 + 1; (e−1)/2
